column1: # Example site list for :publish.
#   ./gradlew :publish:run --args="--sites publish/sites/example.tsv --year 2026 --out build/feed"
# One site per line. Blank lines and everything after a # are ignored.
#   coords    <key> <lat> <lon> <iana-zone> <title...>
#   place-id  <key> <geonamesId> [title...]
# `coords` is preferred: the point is used verbatim and the zone is stated rather than guessed.
# `place-id` borrows a gazetteer record's representative point; ids rather than names because a
# publisher is exactly the caller that cannot answer an interactive "which Raigarh?".
# <key> becomes a directory and a file name in the output, and the `file` field of the legacy
# locations list. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
# This file is an example, not the published set. Sites in zones that observe daylight saving get
# full v1 output but no legacy file — see docs/legacy-contract.md section 5, which is a decision
# waiting on the project owner rather than a settled policy.
